QuestInfo.name: [Kanna] The Sengoku Warriors
QuestInfo.0: In Year 1575 of the Sengoku Era, Matsuyama Sakuno, the last descendent of Abeno Seimei, forms an alliance to oppose Nobunaga, and calls it the Sengoku Warriors.
